login.point2: Hand over to a person in one click
login.point3: Every price and date comes from your own data
channels.intro: Messengers your customers write from. The assistant and your operators answer in the same inbox.
channels.empty: No messenger account is connected yet.
channels.desc.telegram: Customer chats through your Telegram bot, with operator handover to a group or this inbox.
channels.desc.instagram: Instagram direct messages. Not built yet.
channels.desc.whatsapp: WhatsApp Business messages, including message templates. Not built yet.
channels.desc.webchat: A chat widget for your website. Not built yet.
channels.adminNote: Connecting or changing a channel is done by your platform administrator. Self-service setup is planned.
bot.intro: Choose how the assistant takes part in conversations on each connected account.
bot.empty: Connect a messenger account first; then you can switch the assistant on here.
bot.readOnly: Only an owner or admin can change this.
botModeDesc.OFF: The assistant stays silent. Your operators answer every message.
botModeDesc.SHADOW: The assistant prepares replies internally for checking. Customers receive nothing from it.
botModeDesc.LIVE: The assistant answers customers and hands over to an operator when needed.
botRefusal.UNTRUSTED_PROVIDER: Not available: the configured language model provider is not approved for real customer data.
botRefusal.NO_OPERATOR_NOTIFIER: Not available on this server yet: it needs the operator hand-over notifier. Use drafts only.
botRefusal.UNTRUSTED_REAL_DATA: Not available: this is not a test account and the provider is not approved for real customer data.
bot.rule1: Prices, dates and seats come only from your connected data, never from the model's memory.
bot.rule2: It replies in the customer's language and script.
bot.rule3: It hands the conversation to an operator when a customer asks for a person or the topic needs one.
bot.confirmBody: It will start answering customers on this account right away.
knowledge.intro: Questions and answers the assistant may quote word for word. Add what customers ask most.
knowledge.empty: No questions yet. Add the first one.
knowledge.notConfigured: Knowledge search is not set up on this server, so questions cannot be saved yet. Ask your administrator to enable it.
knowledge.readOnly: Only an owner or admin can change questions.
knowledge.question: Question
knowledge.regulatedHint: The assistant answers these only while the entry is recent; otherwise it hands over to a person.
knowledge.consent: I understand this text is sent to the embedding provider and contains nothing confidential.
knowledge.deleteBody: The assistant will stop using it. The change is recorded in the audit log.
errors.MODE_REFUSED: That mode is not allowed right now.
errors.KNOWLEDGE_DISABLED: Knowledge search is not set up on this server.
errors.EMBEDDING_FAILED: The embedding service did not answer. Try again later.
errors.FAQ_LIMIT: The limit of questions is reached.
contacts.intro: Everyone who has written to you, with their latest conversation.
more.intro: Assistant, knowledge, channels and your preferences.
more.desc.bot: Switch the assistant on or off.
more.desc.knowledge: Questions and answers the assistant can quote.
knowledge.importHelp: A CSV file with the columns question and answer (optional: language, regulated), a JSON list, or a text file with Q: and A: blocks. Up to 500 questions and 512 KB.
knowledge.importSame: A question that already exists is updated, not duplicated, so the same file can be uploaded again safely.
knowledge.importReady: {count, plural, one {# question is ready to import} other {# questions are ready to import}}
knowledge.importSkipped: {count, plural, one {# row skipped} other {# rows skipped}}
knowledge.importNothing: Nothing to import in this file.

importProblem.MISSING_TEXT: the question or the answer is empty
importProblem.QUESTION_TOO_SHORT: the question is shorter than 3 characters
importProblem.TOO_MANY: only the first 500 questions are imported
documents.intro: Upload policies, programme descriptions and rules as text. The assistant searches them to answer questions. Prices, dates and seats still come only from your connected data, never from documents.
documents.empty: No documents yet. Upload the first one.
documents.deleteBody: The assistant stops using it. The change is recorded in the audit log.
documents.fileHint: Text files only for now. For PDF or Word, copy the text into the box below.
documents.replaceNote: A document with the same title is replaced.
documents.tooLong: Too long: split the document into parts of at most {max} characters.
errors.DOCUMENT_LIMIT: The limit of documents is reached.
